subheadline: You'll always know what's happening, what you'll get, and when we launch.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.text: Goals, audience, content, and examples. We align on scope and timeline.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: Layout, typography, and UI system that matches your brand and offer.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Clean implementation, responsive polish, and performance-first details.

steps.title: Launch
steps.text: Final QA, deployment, and a smooth handoff so you can run with it.

mindset-subheadline: Technology changes, but the right mindset remains. I believe good software isn't just syntax — it's a tool to solve real problems and create value.

mindset.title: Quick to Adapt
mindset.text: The tech world never stands still. I quickly master new languages, frameworks, and tools to stay relevant and effective.

mindset.title: Detail & Quality
mindset.text: I write clean, readable, and maintainable code. For me, it's not just about making things work, but building them sustainably.

mindset.title: Teamwork
mindset.text: Software is built by people for people. I value feedback, communicate clearly, and ask the right questions so we move forward together.

mindset.title: Growth Oriented
mindset.text: I don't just look for "work," but an environment to grow. I strive to build scalable solutions that last, not just temporary patches.
